meta.title: Burn local treatment, urinary catheterization, benign-lesion destruction & fixed-code singles — clean-room decision tables
meta.derivedFrom: burn-cath-lesion-fixed-cleanroom-spec.md (rule numbers cited per row as specRef)
meta.revised: 2026-09-05 — fixed-code-singles split into four single-code families (nail-trephination, nursemaid-elbow, iv-catheter-placement, nebulizer): a single family with four code-emitting gate tables is unevaluable under meta.semantics.chaining's single-entry convention (evaluation starts at the FIRST code-emitting rowLookup, so subungual.gate's wildcard row would swallow every case). Rows/bands/caps/checklists carried over verbatim; the shared singles.sameDayEm/unitCaps/doc/payerNotes tables were distributed per family (36000 gets no sameDayEm table — it has no E/M PTP edits and the sole-service gate already blocks combined encounters). See scripts/procedure-coding-schema-spike/summary-small-families.md.

semantics.rowLookup: Rows are evaluated top-down; 'when' is a conjunction of exact-equality tests on declared facts; a fact omitted from 'when' is a wildcard; the FIRST matching row wins; 'output' is opaque data returned to the caller. No expressions, no computation.
semantics.threshold: One integer fact banded into contiguous ranges by 'bands' (min/max inclusive, null = unbounded); the matching band's 'output' is returned.
semantics.unitCaps: Per-code maximum billable units per date of service; caps are absolute inputs to claim assembly, never computed.
semantics.docChecklist: All listed items are required documentation for the code; items are human-verified, not computed.
semantics.payerNotes: Free-text constraints surfaced to the human coder; never evaluated.
semantics.chaining: A matched row/band output whose flags contain 'proceed:<tableId>' transfers evaluation to that table (rowLookup or threshold alike); bare 'proceed' means the next code-emitting rowLookup in document order. An output with no proceed flag settles evaluation: its codes (possibly empty) are the emission.

outputConventions.codes: array of {code, units, modifiers[]} claim lines; empty array = no procedure code (E/M pathway per notes)
outputConventions.flags: blocking or advisory strings the caller must surface; 'blocked:*' means do not emit procedure codes

facts.name: treatment_performed
facts.description: Dressings and/or debridement (or, for first-degree, local treatment) were actually performed at this encounter. False = burn evaluated/counseled only. Spec A3.5.

facts.name: burn_depth
facts.description: Deepest documented degree of the burn(s) receiving local treatment. partial_thickness = second-degree (blistering). Spec A3.

facts.name: visit_type
facts.description: Initial vs subsequent encounter for this burn. Only matters for first-degree (16000 is initial-only); 16020-16030 cover both. Spec A3.2/A3.3/A4.

facts.name: tbsa_tenths_treated
facts.description: Total body surface area of the partial-thickness burn(s) treated this session, summed across sites, in TENTHS of a percent (4.5% TBSA = 45; 10% = 100). Tenths resolution makes the 5%/10% descriptor boundaries exact (10.5% = 105 bands as 'greater than 10%'). Spec A2, bespoke-code note 1.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M beyond the decision to perform burn care was performed and documented (clinician attestation). Spec A6.

output.note: Burn evaluated but no dressing/debridement/local treatment: E/M only.
16020-16030 describe partial-thickness burns; full-thickness care belongs to 11042+/15002+ families and usually referral.
First-degree, initial visit, local treatment only.
16000 is initial-only and 16020-16030 require partial thickness; no burn code fits.
Band on summed TBSA of partial-thickness burns treated (initial or subsequent visit alike).

tables.note: Value is TBSA x 10. Boundaries per descriptors: <5% -> 16020; 5% to 10% inclusive -> 16025; >10% -> 16030. Exactly 5% (50) and exactly 10% (100) both band to 16025. One code, one unit per session regardless of number of sites (TBSA summed upstream).

output.note: Partial-thickness treatment without a documented TBSA cannot band; fix documentation.
Active PTP edits bundle 99211-99215 into all four codes (mod 1) — modifier 25 required; 99202-99205/99281-99285 have no edit but the minor-procedure policy applies.
Decision-to-perform E/M is included in the minor procedure (global 000).

required: Anatomic site(s) with laterality
Depth documented as first-degree (epidermis only)
Initial encounter for this burn
Local treatment performed (cleansing, topical agent, dressing) — no more than local treatment required
Who performed the treatment
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25
Anatomic site(s) of each burn with laterality
Depth documented as partial-thickness (second-degree) per site
TBSA percentage per site and summed total, with method (rule of nines / Lund-Browder / burn diagram)
Treatment performed: cleansing, topical agent, dressing type, debridement (what was debrided)
Who performed the treatment
Initial vs subsequent encounter noted
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: One burn-family code per session: PTP 16025x16020, 16030x16020, 16030x16025 are all modifier-indicator 0 (never together). Multiple sites -> sum TBSA into one code. Spec A2.1/B2.1.

Same-day 16000 + 16020-16030 (distinct first-degree and partial-thickness burns) is PTP modifier-indicator 1 — payable only with a distinct-site NCCI modifier; conservative posture is the partial-thickness code alone. Spec A3.7/B2.2 / open question 3.
All four codes are global 000: each dressing-change visit is separately billable (16020-16030 are 'initial or subsequent'); CPT sets no visit limit but payers may. Spec A4.

Site exemplars in 16025/16030 ('whole face or whole extremity', 'more than 1 extremity') are illustrative — the engine bands on TBSA only; exemplar-only documentation needs human review. Spec A2.3 / open question 1.
Cleansing, topical medications, dressings, debridement, local/topical anesthesia, and supplies are integral — never separately coded. Spec A5.
Burn local treatment is Column 2 (mod 1) of same-site debridement 11010-11012, biopsy, and grafting/wound-prep 15002-15278 codes — not separately reportable with those at the same site. Spec B2.5.

facts.name: part_of_other_procedure
facts.description: The catheterization was performed at the time of / just before another procedure, for surgical access, or with any same-day procedure carrying a 000/010/090 global. NCCI Ch7 makes it not separately reportable. Spec A10.

facts.name: catheter_type
facts.description: straight_nonindwelling = in-and-out catheter removed at end of encounter; temporary_indwelling = catheter (e.g., Foley) left in place. Spec A8.1/A8.2.

facts.name: indwelling_insertion_complicated
facts.description: Indwelling insertion required complicated technique: altered anatomy, catheter guide/guide wire, coude/Council-tip for difficult urethra, or difficult removal of retained/fractured catheter plus replacement. Only meaningful for temporary_indwelling (no complicated tier exists for straight cath). Spec A8.3/A8.4.

facts.name: purpose
facts.description: Primary purpose of the catheterization. specimen_collection_only = sole purpose was obtaining urine for UA/culture. Spec A9.

facts.name: payer_type
facts.description: Medicare vs all other payers. Drives 51701 vs P9612 for specimen-only straight cath. Spec A9.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M beyond the decision to catheterize was performed and documented. Spec A11.

output.note: Catheter placed at/just before another procedure, for access, or alongside a same-day global procedure is not separately reportable (NCCI Ch7; 51701/51702 are Column 2 of ~5,800 edits).
Medicare: straight cath solely to obtain a specimen is HCPCS P9612, never 51701 (PTP 51701xP9612 mod 0).
Commercial payers generally accept 51701 for sterile-specimen catheterization (contract-dependent).
Non-indwelling straight cath for PVR, relief drainage, etc. — any payer.
Complicating factor must be concretely documented (altered anatomy, guide wire/catheter guide, difficult removal + replacement).
PTP edits bundle 99211-99215 into 51701-51703 (mod 1) — modifier 25 required; the typical urgent-care visit addressing the underlying condition qualifies when documented.
Decision-to-catheterize E/M is included in the minor procedure (global 000).

notes: Within-family PTP edits are all modifier-indicator 0: 51702x51701, 51703x51701, 51703x51702, and every insertion code x P9612 — exactly one insertion code per day; a failed straight cath converted to Foley codes 51702 only. Spec B6.1/B6.2.
Two same-day catheterizations of the same kind are reported as 2 units of the same code (MUE 2, MAI 3 — appealable clinical cap); the mod-0 edits forbid mixing codes. Spec B7.
NCCI Ch7: 51701-51703 shall not be reported with any procedure carrying a 000/010/090-day global; catheter insertion is part of the global surgical package and of surgical access. Spec A10.
Removal of an indwelling catheter without replacement has no procedure code — it is part of the E/M. Spec A8.5.
There is no complicated tier for straight catheterization: a difficult in-and-out cath is still 51701 (51703 hangs off the indwelling stem). Spec A8.4 / open question 4.
The Medicare specimen-only rule (P9612) rests on PTP mod-0 edits + specialty guidance; no CMS narrative manual passage was located — see spec open question 5.
All three CPT codes are global 000, bilateral indicator 0, multiple-procedure indicator 2. Spec B8.

facts.name: destruction_performed
facts.description: Clinician-performed destruction (cryo/electro/laser/chemical/curettement) was actually carried out this encounter. False = evaluation/prescription only. Spec A14.

facts.name: lesion_category
facts.description: benign_other = benign lesions other than skin tags / vascular proliferative lesions: viral warts (common, plantar, flat), molluscum contagiosum, seborrheic keratoses, milia, other benign neoplasms. Other values route out of this family. Spec A12.

facts.name: lesion_count
facts.description: Exact number of lesions destroyed at this session. Drives the 14/15 boundary. Spec A13.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M beyond the decision to destroy the lesions was performed and documented. Spec A16.

output.note: Skin tags are excluded by the 17110 descriptor.
Premalignant (e.g., actinic keratoses) use the per-lesion 17000-series.
Anogenital condyloma use site-specific codes (e.g., 46900-46924, 54050-54065).
Method of destruction never changes the code (method-agnostic).

tables.note: Flat session codes: units always 1; the two codes are mutually exclusive (PTP 17111x17110 mod 0). Exactly 14 -> 17110; exactly 15 -> 17111.

output.note: 17111 replaces 17110 at 15+; never report both.
PTP edits bundle 99211-99215 into 17110/17111 (mod 1) — modifier 25 required.
Decision-to-perform E/M is included in the minor procedure (10-day global).

caps.source: CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: Code Descriptor / CPT Instruction)
CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: Code Descriptor / CPT Instruction)

required: Lesion type/identity (wart, molluscum, seborrheic keratosis, ...) supporting benign / not skin tag / not vascular proliferative
Exact count of lesions destroyed (drives the 14/15 boundary)
Anatomic site(s) of the lesions
Destruction method (cryotherapy/electrosurgery/laser/chemosurgery/curettement) and clinician performance
Medical necessity (symptomatic, spreading, functional impairment — payer benign-lesion policies apply)
Post-procedure instructions; anesthesia if used (bundled)
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: 17110 and 17111 are mutually exclusive: PTP 17111x17110 is modifier-indicator 0. At 15+ lesions 17111 replaces 17110. Spec A13.2.
Units are always 1 for both codes (MUE 1, MAI 2 — absolute per-day policy caps). Spec B10.
Both codes carry a 10-day global period: decision E/M is bundled (mod 25 for separately identifiable); wound checks within 10 days are included (99024). Spec A16.
Only one removal code per lesion (NCCI Ch3 E): biopsy of the same lesion is included; a destruction begun with one method and completed with another reports only the completed method. Spec A14/A15.
Mixing families same day (17110 + 17000-series, or + 11200) is PTP modifier-indicator 1: allowed only for genuinely distinct lesions with 59/XS. Spec B11.2.
Warts and molluscum belong to 17110/17111 (not the 17000 premalignant series) since the 2007 revision. Spec A12.1.
Benign-lesion destruction is medical-necessity sensitive (cosmetic exclusions) under many payer policies — document symptoms/indication. Spec open question 8.

facts.name: subungual_hematoma_evacuated
facts.description: Subungual hematoma drained through the nail plate (trephination by any method: cautery, heated needle, drill, laser) with the nail left in place. False = observed only. Spec A17.2.

facts.name: nail_plate_avulsed
facts.description: Nail plate was removed/avulsed to treat the injury (routes to 11730; drainage via avulsion is part of the avulsion). Spec A17.3.

facts.name: nail_bed_repair_performed
facts.description: Nail bed laceration was repaired (routes to 11760; 11740 is bundled into nail bed repair). Spec A17.3.

facts.name: digits_treated
facts.description: Number of distinct digits with subungual hematoma evacuation this session. Units up to MUE 2; each line needs its digit modifier (FA/F1-F9/TA/T1-T9), appended by the human coder. Spec A17.5.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M was performed and documented alongside whichever single procedure is being coded (shared attestation fact for this family). Spec A17.4/A18.4/A20.5.

output.note: 11740 is Column 2 (mod 1) of 11760/11762 — the repair code subsumes the evacuation on that digit.
Drainage achieved by removing the nail plate is part of the avulsion (11740 is Column 2 of 11730, mod 1).

tables.note: 11740 units = distinct digits trephined, capped at the MUE (2). Digit modifiers (FA/F1-F9/TA/T1-T9) are digit-specific and appended by the human coder — the table cannot know which digits (surfaced as an advisory flag).

output.note: MUE (MAI 3) caps billable units at 2; the excess denies but is appealable with records.

tables.note: PTP bundles 99211-99215 into 11740 (mod 1) — modifier 25 on a separately identifiable E/M. Spec A17.4.

output.note: For 11740/24640 the decision-to-perform E/M is included (minor procedure).

caps.source: CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: Clinical: Data)

required: Digit(s) treated, each with its digit modifier (FA/F1-F9/TA/T1-T9)
Mechanism of trauma and clinical findings (subungual hematoma; distal phalanx exam)
X-ray/fracture status if assessed (imaging separately reportable)
Trephination method (cautery/heated needle/drill/laser)
Drainage achieved; nail plate left intact
Aftercare instructions
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: 11740: global 000; Column 2 (mod 1) of nail avulsion 11730, nail bed repair 11760/11762, nail excisions 11750/11765, same-site laceration repairs 12001-12042 and I&D 10060/10061 — one service per digit absent a distinct-site modifier. Spec A17.3/A17.4.

facts.name: elbow_condition
facts.description: Documented elbow condition in the child. true_dislocation_or_fracture routes out (24600/24605 or fracture codes); other = no subluxation confirmed. Spec A18.2/A18.3.

facts.name: elbow_manipulation_performed
facts.description: Reduction manipulation (supination-flexion or hyperpronation) actually performed. False (spontaneous reduction/observation) = E/M only. Spec A18.2.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M was performed and documented alongside whichever single procedure is being coded (shared attestation fact for this family). Spec A17.4/A18.4/A20.5.

output.note: True elbow dislocation -> 24600/24605; radial head/neck fracture -> 24650+/24665-24666. 24640 is Column 2 (mod 1) of all four.
Spontaneous reduction or observation only: the descriptor requires manipulation.
Sling/splint applied as part of treatment is included (NCCI Ch4).

tables.note: PTP bundles 99211-99215 into 24640 (mod 1) — modifier 25 on a separately identifiable E/M (some legacy payers took 57; see payer notes). Spec A18.4.

output.note: For 11740/24640 the decision-to-perform E/M is included (minor procedure).

caps.source: CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: CMS Policy)

required: Child patient; mechanism (longitudinal traction — pulled/lifted/swung by the arm)
Presentation: arm held limp/pronated, refusal to use; no findings suggesting fracture/dislocation
Diagnosis: radial head subluxation with laterality (ICD-10 S53.03- family)
Manipulation technique (supination-flexion or hyperpronation); click if felt
Post-reduction recovery of arm use
X-ray if obtained (separately reportable)
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: 24640: global 010, MUE 1 with MAI 2 (CMS Policy) — same-day re-reduction is not separately payable; recurrence on a later day within the 10-day global is a payer-level 76/78 question (spec open question 7). Bilateral indicator 1: bilateral reduction reports modifier 50. Spec A18.5.
24640 vs E/M: most payers take modifier 25 on the E/M; some legacy payer/AAP guidance used modifier 57 — payer contract dependent. Spec A18.4.

facts.name: venous_access_sole_service
facts.description: Introduction of needle/catheter into a vein was the ONLY service of the encounter — no infusion, injection, or other procedure followed. NCCI Ch1: 36000 may be reported alone only then. Spec A19.2.

facts.name: venous_payer_type
facts.description: Payer for the standalone 36000 claim. Medicare status B = never separately paid even when reportable. Spec A19.3.

output.note: IV access is integral to infusions/injections (96360-96379 include it), surgery, anesthesia, contrast and nuclear procedures — 36000 is Column 2 of 6,575 active PTP edits. Code the infusion/injection service instead.
Reportable alone per NCCI Ch1, but MPFS status B: Medicare never pays 36000 separately.
Payable per commercial contract when venous access was the sole service (e.g., IV placed, patient transferred before infusion).

caps.source: CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: Clinical: Data)

required: Site and vein; needle/catheter gauge
Indication for venous access
That NO infusion, injection, or other procedure followed at this encounter (sole-service condition)
Disposition (e.g., transferred with IV in place)

notes: 36000: MPFS status B — bundled; Medicare never pays it separately in any scenario, even reported alone. Commercial payability is contract-dependent. Spec A19.3.

facts.name: neb_treatment_context
facts.description: Why the inhalation treatment was given. bronchodilator_for_spirometry_study = the aerosol was the bronchodilator of a 94060 responsiveness study (misuse of 94640); none = no treatment given. Spec A20.1/A20.3.

facts.name: neb_continuous_over_one_hour
facts.description: Inhalation drugs administered as a continuous treatment or back-to-back series exceeding one hour (routes to 94644/94645 instead of 94640). Spec A20.2.4.

facts.name: neb_episodes_of_care
facts.description: Number of separate episodes of care with inhalation treatment on this date (episode = arrival to departure; back-to-back treatments within one episode still count as ONE). Spec A20.2.

facts.name: em_separately_identifiable
facts.description: A significant, separately identifiable E/M was performed and documented alongside whichever single procedure is being coded (shared attestation fact for this family). Spec A17.4/A18.4/A20.5.

output.note: 94060 includes the bronchodilator administration; reporting 94640 for it is a misuse (NCCI Ch11 7; PTP 94060x94640 mod 1).
Continuous or back-to-back treatments exceeding one hour report 94644 (+94645), not 94640 (PTP 94644x94640 mod 0).
acute_airway_obstruction and sputum_induction both band on episodes of care.

tables.note: One unit per episode of care regardless of back-to-back treatments within it; the 2nd+ same-date episode carries modifier 76 (NCCI Ch11 8). Lines are enumerated because MUE caps episodes at 4 (no computation in the vocabulary).

output.note: MUE (MAI 3) caps at 4/date; the excess denies but is appealable with records.

tables.note: 94640 carries PTP edits (Column 1) against ALL office and ED E/M levels, 99202-99215 and 99281-99285 (mod 1) — modifier 25 always required on the same-day E/M. Spec A20.5.

output.note: For 11740/24640 the decision-to-perform E/M is included (minor procedure).

caps.source: CMS MUE practitioner table eff. 2026-10-01 (rationale: Clinical: Data)

required: Indication: acute airway obstruction (wheezing/bronchospasm) or sputum induction
Drug, dose, and device (nebulizer/MDI/IPPB) — inhaled medication separately reportable
Who administered; clinician supervision
Pre- and post-treatment assessment (breath sounds, respiratory rate, SpO2, response)
Time of each treatment; number of back-to-back treatments (still 1 unit within an episode)
For repeat billing (modifier 76): the separate episodes — departure and return times
If E/M also billed: separately identifiable E/M documentation supporting modifier 25

notes: 94640: only once per episode of care (arrival to departure) no matter how many back-to-back treatments; separate same-date episodes use modifier 76 on additional lines. Some payers prefer 2 units on one line with 76 — payer note (spec open question 10). Spec A20.2.

94640 vs spirometry: 94010/94060/94070 x 94640 are mod-1 edits; when 94640 treats acute obstruction, pre/post spirometry is not separately reportable, and 94640 is never reported for the bronchodilator of a 94060 study. Spec A20.3.
94640 vs 94664 (device demonstration): included when same device/same encounter (mod 1); separately reportable only at a separate encounter on the same date. Spec A20.4.
Inhaled medication (e.g., J7613 albuterol) is separately reportable with 94640 per NCCI Ch11. Spec A20.3.3.
94640 carries PTP edits against ALL office and ED E/M levels (99202-99215, 99281-99285, mod 1) — the same-day E/M always needs modifier 25. Spec A20.5.
